title: 第53章 猎杀两只大野猪，赚大了

第53章 猎杀两只大野猪，赚大了-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

这头即将四百斤的野猪，浑身满是污垢，也就是俗称的挂甲，成年的野猪喜欢去挑破松树的皮，让松树的松脂挂在自己的身上，再到地上打滚，而且专门找那种满是沙粒子的地方打滚，让身体形成一道更加坚固的甲。

一来一去，反复操作。

身上的盔甲就会越来越重，越来越厚，野猪之所以这么干，一方面是为了防止老林子的蚊子叮咬，还可以防止气味外泄，以免被狩猎者发现。

野猪这东西毕竟是猪！

猪皮坚韧，有些地方的皮肤甚至能够达到两厘米，身体还会分泌出一些东西，就像是老茧一样，覆盖在皮肤上，加上松脂这些东西，变得更加坚固。

而且。

在野猪皮下面，还有三四厘米厚度的脂肪，在撞击敌人的时候，就像是重型坦克。

一旦野猪受到惊吓，慌不择路，或者护崽子的时候，有概率朝着人撞击过来，那感受就可想而知了。

有些猎人会饲养猎狗猎杀野猪。

一群头狗先冲过去，然后快帮挂住，最后重托匆忙赶到，纷纷咬住野猪的脖子和耳朵，将其死死的坠在地上，猎人冲上去用刀子一下子捅到心脏的位置。

原本还厉害的野猪，瞬间就没了力气。

要是猎狗饲养的多，有概率直接将眼前这八九只全部给猎了。

可惜。

如今自己身边只有一条头狗，靠大黄肯定没用，只能一枪再留下来一只了。

“嘭！”

一道响亮的声音在老林子内回荡，独头弹瞬间飞射而出，没入这头四百斤野猪的耳朵中，从耳道直接钻入脑袋里。

“嘭！”

接近四百斤的野猪重重跌倒在地上，惊起满地灰尘。

“吱吱吱……！”

一群野猪顿时发出一道道刺耳的声音，匆匆朝着远处逃窜，李青山等人相视一笑

中了！！

等到野猪全部跑远了后，李青山等人才围过去，一只三百斤，一只接近四百斤的野猪，就这么躺在地上，鲜血顺着耳道流淌出来，还散发着温热的气息。

“刀！”

李青山朝着大壮一伸手，一把柴刀便落在李青山手中，手起刀落，重重落在被迷翻了的野猪脖颈处，这一刀直接砍到了骨头，这被麻翻了的野猪瞬间惊醒。

然而。

还未来得及反应，李青山第二刀便再次落了下去，骨头都被崩碎了，大量鲜血流淌出来。

“吱吱吱……！”

这野猪发出一道道嘶鸣，想要从地上爬起来，却已经没了机会，随着李青山一道道落下，一枚完整的猪头便被李青山劈了下来。

李青山的力量在纯阳真气的加持下，可比一般人要重多了。

否则的话。

李青山会先考虑攮野猪的心脏，再放血肢解！！

站在一旁的大壮和赵红旗等人，望着如此血腥暴力的李青山，相互对视一眼，眼神中满是敬畏之色。

山哥可真狠啊！！

这样的人，说杀过人自己都信。

李青山将两只野猪的猪血全部放出来，大壮和赵红旗在旁边用泥土掩埋。

Chapter 53: Hunting two big wild boars and making a lot of money - "Chasing the Mountain 1957: Two pounds of pork in exchange for a wife"

Previous chapter

Save bookmarks

Next chapter

This nearly 400-pound wild boar is covered in dirt, which is commonly known as armor. Adult wild boars like to break through the bark of pine trees, let the pine resin hang on their bodies, and then roll on the ground. They also specifically look for places full of sand particles to roll in, so that their bodies form a stronger armor.

Come and go, repeat the operation.

The armor on the body will become heavier and thicker. The reason why the wild boar does this is to prevent mosquito bites in the old forest, and also to prevent the smell from leaking out, so as to avoid being discovered by hunters.

The wild boar is a pig after all!

Pigskin is tough, and in some places the skin can even reach two centimeters. The body also secretes something, like calluses, to cover the skin, and with the addition of rosin and other things, it becomes stronger.

and.

Under the boar skin, there is still three to four centimeters of fat. When it hits the enemy, it looks like a heavy tank.

Once a wild boar is frightened and panics, or when protecting its cubs, there is a chance that the wild boar will collide with a person, you can imagine how it feels.

Some hunters keep hunting dogs to hunt wild boars.

A group of leading dogs rushed over first, and then quickly helped to catch it. Finally, Zhongtuo rushed over, biting the wild boar's neck and ears one after another, and dropped it to the ground. The hunter rushed forward and stabbed the wild boar to the heart with a knife.

The wild boar, which was so powerful at first, lost all its strength in an instant.

If there are many hunting dogs, there is a chance that all the eight or nine dogs in front of you will be hunted.

pity.

Now that I only have one head dog by my side, it is definitely useless to rely on rhubarb. I can only keep one more dog with one shot.

"Bang!"

A loud sound echoed in the old forest, and the single-head bullet flew out instantly, penetrated into the ear of the 400-pound wild boar, and penetrated directly into the head from the ear canal.

"Bang!"

The wild boar, which weighed nearly 400 kilograms, fell heavily to the ground and stirred up dust all over the ground.

"Squeak, squeak, squeak...!"

A group of wild boars suddenly made a harsh sound and hurriedly fled into the distance. Li Qingshan and others looked at each other and smiled.

Hit!!

After all the wild boars ran away, Li Qingshan and others gathered around. One wild boar weighed 300 kilograms and the other nearly 400 kilograms were lying on the ground, with blood flowing down the ear canal and exuding a warm breath.

"Knife!"

Li Qingshan stretched out his hand towards Da Zhuang, and a hatchet fell into Li Qingshan's hand. He raised the knife and landed heavily on the neck of the stunned wild boar. The knife directly hit the bone, and the stunned wild boar woke up instantly.

However.

Before he could react, Li Qingshan's second knife fell again. His bones were shattered and a large amount of blood flowed out.

"Squeak, squeak, squeak...!"

The wild boar neighed one after another and tried to get up from the ground, but it had no chance. As Li Qingshan fell one after another, a complete pig head was chopped off by Li Qingshan.

Li Qingshan's power is much stronger than that of ordinary people, thanks to the blessing of pure Yang Qi.

Otherwise.

Li Qingshan would first consider tearing out the heart of the wild boar, and then bloodletting and dismembering it!!

Da Zhuang, Zhao Hongqi and others standing aside looked at each other with such bloody and violent Li Qingshan, their eyes full of awe.

Brother Shan is so cruel!!

Such a person would believe it even if he said he had killed someone.

Li Qingshan released all the blood from the two wild boars, while Da Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi buried it with soil nearby.
